name: Apple Q4 2024 Earnings
query: What were Apple's Q4 2024 earnings per share?

chunks.text: Apple reported Q4 2024 EPS of $1.64, beating analyst estimates of $1.60. Revenue grew 6% YoY to $94.9B driven by iPhone 16 demand and continued Services momentum.
Apple's supply chain partners in Vietnam expanded capacity by 15% in early 2023 to reduce China dependency. The shift is expected to lower production costs by 8% over three years.
Tim Cook stated in the Q4 2024 earnings call that Services revenue hit an all-time high of $24.97B, with Apple Intelligence driving increased App Store engagement.

name: Fed Interest Rate Policy
query: What is the current Federal Reserve interest rate policy?

chunks.text: The Fed held rates at 5.25-5.5% at its September 2023 meeting, signaling potential cuts in 2024 if inflation data continues to moderate toward the 2% target.
Federal Reserve minutes from December 2024 indicate consensus around gradual rate cuts through 2025, with the dot plot median projecting 3.75-4.0% by year-end 2025.
Fed Chair Powell's 2022 Jackson Hole speech signaled aggressive rate hikes to combat 9.1% CPI inflation, marking the beginning of the fastest tightening cycle since the 1980s.

name: NVIDIA AI Revenue Growth
query: How is NVIDIA's data center revenue trending?

chunks.text: NVIDIA reported Q3 FY2025 data center revenue of $14.5B, up 279% YoY, driven by H100/H200 GPU demand from hyperscalers and enterprise AI adoption.
NVIDIA announced the Blackwell B200 GPU architecture in March 2024, promising 4x the training performance of H100 at similar power consumption.
NVIDIA's gaming segment revenue declined 2% in FY2023 as crypto mining demand evaporated and consumers delayed GPU upgrades.
